title: devops-cookbook template
description: Metadata of one template, stored in <category>/<template>/template.yaml.

category.description: Category folder name, usually the main tool.

summary.description: One sentence on what the template is.

tools.description: Tools the template is built and tested with, each at an exact version.

version.description: Exact version, quoted. No ranges, wildcards or 'latest'.

use_when.description: Short phrases: situations the template fits.

avoid_when.description: Short phrases: situations where another approach is better.

variables.description: Every value meant to be changed. Anything not listed stays as it is.

name.description: Variable name as the tool spells it.

default.description: Value the files use as they are. null only when the user has to supply it, such as a token.

where.description: File that sets the variable, relative to the template's files/ folder.

practices.description: Decisions the template follows. Keep them when applying the template.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the template.

checks.description: What CI verifies for this template.

backs.description: Profile 'Selected work' item this template supports.

slug.description: Lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens.

line.description: Non-empty text on a single line.
